item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Adds Obsidian vaults with locally selected folders and per-token read/write access. List, search, read, create, replace, append, and trash Markdown notes without a plugin. Revision checks and recoverable prior versions protect editing. Existing tokens and settings retain their permissions; Obsidian starts disabled with no vaults selected. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: Adds Apple Reminders with locally selected lists and per-token read/write access. Read, search, create, edit, complete, reopen, and delete reminders, with deadlines, priority, notes, URLs and alarms. Existing tokens and settings retain their permissions. Reminders starts disabled and requires its own local permission grant. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: Calendar now supports creating, editing, and deleting personal events in selected writable calendars. New read & write tokens grant Calendar edits; existing tokens keep their permissions. Updates and deletion require the current event revision and affect one recurring occurrence at a time. Events with attendees or an organizer remain read-only. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: Things MCP is now MacMCP. Adds read-only Apple Mail and Calendar integrations with explicit source selection and per-token app permissions. Existing Things tokens, settings, and endpoints are preserved. Mail and Calendar start disabled. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description: Initial release. Things MCP server for local and network clients, scoped access tokens, menu bar controls, launch at login, and on-demand Things automation. Universal, Developer ID signed and notarized.
